patch_description: Replace the lagging exponential moving average with a robust, weighted local-linear endpoint estimator. Each trailing window estimates its local slope using exponentially weighted regression, clips large residuals with a Huber-style reweighting pass, and applies only a bounded fraction of the inferred trend correction to the weighted level estimate. This substantially reduces moving-average phase lag while retaining smoothing. The robust residual pass prevents isolated spikes from biasing the slope and causing false reversals; the final light causal continuity blend further suppresses short one-sample directional changes without adding meaningful latency.
